Puja Sur 

	 +91 8600193603 	 pujasur610@gmail.com           	 www.linkedin.com/in/puja-sur-16083120a/ 

 Pune, MH 

Career Objective 

To leverage 4 years of experience in Microsoft Power Platform development, including Power Apps and Power Automate, to design scalable business solutions that drive digital transformation, process automation, and data-driven decision-making. 

Experience Summary 

Designed and developed 10+ business applications using Power Apps with responsive UI and reusable components, improving adoption and efficiency by 40%.

Automated 50+ workflows with Power Automate for approvals, notifications, and data processing, cutting manual effort by 70% and streamlining processes.

Created and managed SharePoint Online lists, libraries, and content solutions with advanced permissions, dynamic provisioning, and UI enhancements using JSON formatting, reducing access issues by 25%.

Built relational data models and model-driven apps in Dataverse,

Worked on Power BI proof-of-concepts (POCs) to deliver real-time analytics and reporting for business insights.

Implemented AI Builder for document automation, extracting data from PDFs and invoices with 85% accuracy, minimizing manual entry.

Consistently recognized for delivering quality solutions, following best practices, and contributing to project success.

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE 

Cognizant Technology Solutions | Pune, IN 	Feb '22 - Present 

Associate  

Developing and implementing custom solutions using SharePoint and Power Platform to meet customer needs. 

Led the optimization of user access, data management, and communication through custom Power Platform solution, resulting in enhanced efficiency

EDUCATION 

Gondwana University | Chandrapur, MH 

Bachelor’s degree in civil engineering from Rajiv Gandhi College of Engineering, Research & Technology, Chandrapur 

KEY SKILLS 

Operating System - Windows 

Tools - Power Apps, Power Automate, Power Virtual Agents/Copilot Studio, Model Driven App, AI Builder, Graph API



Frontend Technologies – HTML5, CSS3 Database – SharePoint, Dataverse 

CERTIFICATIONS 

Microsoft Power Platform Fundamentals (PL-900)

Microsoft Azure Fundamentals (AZ-900)

Microsoft Certified Power Platform App Maker (PL-100)

PROJECTS 

GDS Timesheet Management System | Sanofi 	 

Team Size - 2 | Role - Developer | Environment - Power Apps & Power Automate 

Developed a Timesheet Management App with Copy Timesheet, automated reminders, escalation handling, and validations, improving visibility and reducing manual effort by ~40%. 

Responsibilities:

Participated in requirement collecting at the beginning of the project to ensure clear goals and alignment.

Involved in technical implementation based on client requirements.

Built dashboards with search, filter, and effort calculation logic for employees/vendors.

Automated weekly reminders and escalation notifications to reduce delays.

Implemented Copy Timesheet and validation rules to minimize data entry errors

Involved in group meetings with managers and team members to discuss status updates, issues, and knowledge exchange.

Involved in giving KT to the client, Support team and technical design documentation.

Protocol Management & Expert Tool | Regeneron 	 

Team Size - 2 | Role – Developer | Environment - Power Apps & Power Automate 

Designed and delivered a Power Apps application with multiple screens to streamline protocol management. On submission, data was stored in SharePoint for centralized tracking. Implemented a role-based search to help users quickly locate uploaded documents and training resources. Leveraged Lucid wireframes during requirement gathering, resulting in a 40% improvement in protocol submission efficiency and 30% faster approval turnaround time. 

Responsibilities:

Participated in requirement collecting at the beginning of the project to ensure clear goals and alignment.

Used Lucid wireframes for requirement validation.

Conducted UAT sessions for clients.

Involved in group meetings with managers and team members to discuss status updates, issues, and knowledge exchange.

Team CHiC Project Tool | Regeneron 	 

Team Size - 2 | Role - Developer | Environment - Power Apps & Power Automate 

Developed a complex Power Apps solution with multi-level approval workflows and a custom dashboard replicating a SharePoint-like experience without exposing backend lists. Integrated advanced features such as filtering, sorting, search, in-app commenting, and export to Excel for reporting. The solution reduced manual effort by 45% and improved project visibility by 35%. 

Responsibilities:

Participated in requirement collecting at the beginning of the project to ensure clear goals and alignment.



Involved in technical implementation based on client requirements.

Designed and implemented multi-level approval workflows.

Built Power Apps dashboard with advanced features including export to Excel.

Involved in group meetings with managers and team members to discuss status updates, issues, and knowledge exchange.

Copilot Studio – Clinical Trial FAQ & SOP Bot | Regeneron 	 

Team Size - 3 | Role - Developer | Environment - Power Apps & Power Automate 

Built a Copilot Studio chatbot integrated with SharePoint Lists and Document Libraries to provide clinical trial FAQs, timelines, and SOPs. Connected with Teams and Power Automate to enable real-time responses and streamline trial information access, reducing manual effort and improving transparency. 

Responsibilities:

Participated in requirement collecting at the beginning of the project to ensure clear goals and alignment.

Involved in technical implementation based on client requirements.

Built conversational flows in Copilot Studio for clinical trial FAQs.

Integrated SharePoint List/Library for trial data and SOPs.

Automated data retrieval using Power Automate and deployed bot in Microsoft Teams for end-user access.

Optimized user experience with real-time filtering and intuitive navigation, reducing manual coordination efforts.

Involved in giving KT to the client, Support team and technical design documentation
